§6Trinitite Glass§f

§aThe glassy residue of nuclear detonations.§f
§bTrinitite Glass§f is created when a nuclear bomb detonates. It forms as blocks in the blast zone, replacing the terrain that was there before. Collect it for use in advanced recipes and as a unique decorative block.

Trinitite is used in some high-tier crafting recipes. It's a reminder of what you just did to that chunk of terrain, and a material that can't be obtained any other way.

§ePS:§f Trinitite Glass can be mined with any pickaxe. It's not particularly rare if you're blowing up bombs regularly, but save some for crafting before you start building nuclear test sites.
